note: Round 39 (Jake): a light first pass of training language. Keyed by pack (the model's pack name) or by model file; walk.js shows it in the ? bubble that appears over a unit once you start working with it: what it is, how it works, what we check. Copied to the viewer with placements.json. Keep it plain and short; Jake will detail these.

gas_tank_water_heater.what: A gas fired storage water heater. A tank of water kept hot by a burner under it, vented up a flue.
gas_tank_water_heater.how: Cold water comes in the dip tube to the bottom. The thermostat opens the gas valve, the burner heats the tank, the flue carries the exhaust out the roof. Hot water leaves the top.
checks: T&P relief valve: present, piped to within 6 in of the floor, no cap, no corrosion
Venting: draft hood, proper rise, no rust or soot at the draft hood
Gas: drip leg, shutoff, no leaks at the union
Expansion tank where the system is closed
Sediment: flush the drain, listen for rumble
Condition of the flame: blue, steady, no rollout

electric_tank_water_heater.what: An electric storage water heater. Two elements in a tank, upper and lower, each on its own thermostat.
electric_tank_water_heater.how: The upper element heats the top first, then hands off to the lower element. 240 volt feed through a disconnect. No vent, no flame.
checks: T&P relief valve and its discharge line
Thermostats and the high limit (reset button)
Leaks at the fittings and the pan drain

gas_tankless_water_heater.what: A condensing gas tankless. Heats water only when a tap opens, no tank.
gas_tankless_water_heater.how: Flow sensor sees the tap, the fan starts, gas lights in the sealed burner, water runs through the heat exchanger. Condensate drains out the bottom. PVC intake and exhaust through the wall.
checks: Descale the heat exchanger (isolation valves and a pump)
Condensate line and neutralizer where required

electric_tankless_water_heater.what: An electric tankless. Heating elements in chambers, no tank, big electrical load.
electric_tankless_water_heater.how: Flow sensor sees the tap, the board staggers the elements on to hit the set point. Needs several 240 volt circuits.
checks: Breaker sizes and wire gauge match the unit
Flow rate versus the unit's rating

hybrid_water_heater.what: A heat pump water heater. A small heat pump on top of a tank pulls heat from the room air into the water.
hybrid_water_heater.how: The fan pulls room air over the evaporator, the compressor moves that heat into the tank. Elements back it up. Condensate drains from the top unit.
checks: Room volume and clearances for the air it needs

hvac_furnace.what: A gas furnace. The blower pushes house air over a heat exchanger warmed by the burners.
hvac_furnace.how: The thermostat calls, the inducer proves draft, the spark lights the burners, the blower runs after the exchanger warms. Exhaust goes out the flue (or PVC on a condensing unit).

hvac_air_handler.what: The indoor half of a split system. A blower and a coil in a cabinet, in the attic here.
hvac_air_handler.how: The blower pulls return air over the coil (cold in cooling, warm in heat pump mode) and pushes it down the ducts. Condensate drains from the pan.
checks: Primary drain clear, float switch in the secondary pan

hvac_condenser.what: The outdoor unit of a split air conditioner. Compressor, condenser coil and fan.
hvac_condenser.how: Refrigerant absorbs heat inside, the compressor pumps it out here, the fan blows outdoor air across the coil to dump that heat.

hvac_package.what: A gas pack: furnace and air conditioner in one outdoor cabinet, ducted through the wall.
hvac_package.how: Everything the split system does, in one box outside. Supply and return ducts run through the wall.

hvac_minisplit.what: A ductless mini split. A wall head inside, an inverter unit outside, a line set between.
hvac_minisplit.how: The outdoor inverter varies the compressor speed. The line set carries refrigerant to the head, which blows over its own coil. Condensate drains from the head.
checks: Line set insulation and the wall sleeve

kitchen_sink.what: The kitchen sink: faucet, strainers, disposal, trap and the dishwasher connection.
kitchen_sink.how: Supply stops feed the faucet. Waste falls through the strainer or the disposal into the trap, then the drain. The dishwasher drains through the disposal.
checks: Leaks at the stops, the supply lines, the trap
Disposal: splash guard, mount, cord, does it turn
Dishwasher drain high loop or air gap

disposal.what: The garbage disposal. A grinder under the sink on its own circuit.
disposal.how: The switch runs the motor, the turntable throws food against the grind ring, water carries it out the discharge into the trap.
checks: Reset button and the hex wrench
Splash guard and mount gasket for leaks

toilet.what: A gravity toilet: tank and bowl.
toilet.how: The flapper lifts, the tank dumps into the bowl, the siphon pulls the bowl down, the fill valve refills the tank and the bowl.
checks: Wax ring: rocking, water at the base

bath_vanity.what: The bathroom lavatory: faucet, pop up drain, trap.
bath_vanity.how: Stops feed the faucet, the pop up lifts by its linkage, waste goes down the tailpiece to the trap.

shower.what: The tub and shower: valve, spout, head, drain and overflow.
shower.how: One valve mixes hot and cold, the diverter sends it up to the head. Waste goes down the drain shoe and the overflow to the trap.

water_filter.what: A whole house water filter on the service line.
water_filter.how: All the house water passes through the housing and its cartridge before the main.

septic_lee.what: An aerobic treatment unit (Lee precast) with spray heads.
septic_lee.how: Sewage settles, the aerator blower bubbles air through it, the clarifier settles it again, chlorine treats it, the pump sprays the treated water on the lawn.
checks: Pump and float in the pump chamber
Plug in wiring: the air pump at its receptacle, the pump and float splices under the lid (no panel on this plant)

septic_atu.what: An aerobic treatment unit: an aerator, a clarifier and a pump.
septic_atu.how: Air from the blower keeps the bacteria working, the clarifier settles the solids, the pump sends treated water out.

septic_tank.what: A conventional septic tank feeding a drain field.
septic_tank.how: Solids settle in the tank, the baffles hold the scum, the clear water flows out to the field by gravity.
checks: Sludge and scum level (pump when it is a third full)

septic_field.what: The drain field and its distribution box.
septic_field.how: The D box splits the tank's outflow evenly into the field lines, where it soaks into the soil.
checks: No roots or driving over it

pump_tank.what: A pump tank: the second tank of a two tank spray system.
pump_tank.how: Treated water collects here, a float starts the pump, it sprays the lawn through the heads.
checks: Cord and plug (the plug in wiring in the riser)

pump_wiring.what: The plug in wiring for a spray pump: gray UF cable into the riser, splices to the pump and the float.
pump_wiring.how: Power comes in the UF cable through the cord grip, the float switch breaks the hot to the pump, the splices are crimped and heat shrunk, zip tied high in the riser out of the moisture.
checks: Zip tie at the lip, cords clear of the discharge

lift_station.what: A lift station: a pump that pushes sewage up to the city sewer when gravity cannot.
lift_station.how: Sewage collects in the basin, the float starts the pump, it pushes up the force main through the check valve to the sewer.

sump_pump.what: A sump pump in a basin.
sump_pump.how: Water collects, the float starts the pump, it pumps out the discharge.

smart_shutoff_valve.what: An automatic (Flo) shutoff valve on the main.
smart_shutoff_valve.how: It watches flow and pressure and closes the valve on a leak or by the app.

flo_shutoff.what: An automatic (Flo) shutoff valve on the main.
flo_shutoff.how: It watches flow and pressure and closes the valve on a leak or by the app.

flo_shutoff_attic.what: An automatic (Flo) shutoff valve on the attic cold run.
flo_shutoff_attic.how: It watches flow and pressure and closes on a leak. The brick plugs into the attic receptacle.

flo_shutoff_wall.what: An automatic (Flo) shutoff valve at the wall.
flo_shutoff_wall.how: It watches flow and pressure and closes on a leak.

electric_panel.what: The load centre: the main breaker and the branch breakers.
electric_panel.how: The service feeds the main, the bus feeds each breaker, each breaker feeds a circuit. HVAC, water heater and septic have their own.

whole_house_spd.what: A whole house surge protector in the panel.
whole_house_spd.how: It clamps surges on the bus to ground before they reach the circuits.

outlet_surge.what: A surge receptacle at the air pump.
outlet_surge.how: It clamps surges on that circuit.

hvac_surge.what: A surge protector at the condenser disconnect.
hvac_surge.how: It clamps surges before the condenser's contactor and board.

easystart.what: A soft starter on the condenser.
easystart.how: It ramps the compressor up instead of slamming it on, cutting the start current.

sweet_air.how: A valve on the wall with a hose thread. Frost free ones have the seat inside the wall.

water_softener.what: A water softener in the garage: hard water in, soft water out. Resin beads trade their sodium for the calcium and magnesium that scale up heaters and fixtures.
water_softener.how: Water passes down through the resin bed and up the riser tube. When the meter says the bed is spent the valve backwashes, draws brine from the salt tank through the resin to recharge it, rinses, and refills the brine tank. The bypass valve takes it out of the line for service.
checks: Bypass levers in SERVICE, not bypass
Salt level and no salt bridge (push a broom handle through the salt)
Brine float free, brine well clean
Regen time set at night, hardness set to the test
Drain line to the standpipe with an air gap, not kinked
Hardness test at a tap after regen
Resin age: over ten years and it is tired
Power to the head, time showing

pressure_tank.what: The well's pressure tank: a diaphragm tank with air on top and water below, so the pump does not start every time a tap opens.
pressure_tank.how: The pump fills the tank until the pressure switch opens at cut out (60 psi); the air charge pushes water out as taps run; at cut in (40 psi) the switch starts the pump again.
checks: Air charge 2 psi under cut in with the tank empty
No short cycling (a waterlogged tank starts the pump every few seconds)
Disconnect labelled, wire size right for the pump

well_pump.what: A submersible pump down a 6 in cased well, pushing water up the drop pipe and out through the pitless adapter to the house.
well_pump.how: The pressure switch at the tank starts it. Water enters the intake screen, the stages push it up the drop pipe, the check valve above the pump holds the column when it stops. The pitless adapter passes the line through the casing below frost.
checks: Cap sealed and vented, casing 12 in over grade
Splice and cable condition at the pull
Grade slopes away from the casing

condensate_pump.what: A small pump that lifts the condensing furnace's water to a drain when there is no gravity path from the closet.
condensate_pump.how: Condensate runs from the furnace trap into the reservoir; the float lifts and runs the pump up the 3/8 in tube to the drain. The safety switch opens the furnace's call for heat if the reservoir overfills.
checks: Check valve and discharge tube not kinked, routed to a real drain
Safety switch wired to the furnace and tested
A test pour: it runs and stops
No water on the closet floor

lift_station_duplex.what: A duplex lift station: two grinder pumps on guide rails in one basin, pushing sewage up to the city sewer. Two pumps so the house still drains when one is down.
lift_station_duplex.how: Four floats on a tree run it. STOP and LEAD start the lead pump. If the water keeps rising, LAG brings the second pump on. ALARM lights the beacon. The panel swaps the lead pump every cycle so both wear evenly. Each pump lifts out on its chain, up its rail, with nothing to unbolt.
checks: Each pump in HAND: 15 amps running on the clamp, and the level drops
Lead pump alternates from one cycle to the next
Float order and action: stop, lead, lag, alarm
TEST button: beacon and horn. Fuses F1 and F2 good
Check valves hold, ball valves open, handles along the pipe
Pumps seated on their base elbows, chains and rails sound
Junction box dry, cord grips tight
Lid bolted, gasket good, vent clear
